data.name: UnknownGap
data.comment: Empty: a gap without a code is shown by its own text.

data.value: characters without a glyph in any font left out (PDF/A forbids the .notdef glyph)

data.value: footnote numbers restarting at each page may not match their final page

data.name: TightWrapByBoundingBox
data.value: tight and through wrapping follows the bounding box of floating shapes

data.value: text does not flow around floating shapes in tables, headers and footers

data.value: Arabic letters drawn without joining forms
